notes.title: Polar Star - The Revisit Update
notes.notes:
Polar Star is out and on sale!

Polar Star is on a 10% discount until September, 23!

 CHANGELOG:[previewyoutube="cT6e5dsUwuY;full"][/previewyoutube]FEATURES
Now you can revisit any day separately and without tutorials.

RESET button now resets your personal best score, locks you out of arcade mode and resets your story mode progress.  
FIXES
Fixed a typo in day 2.

Fixed a bug where day 1 dialogue would play in the ARCADE mode.
